'''Öetrago''', or '''Oetrago''', was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWR" /><ref name="CE" /> located within the [[Öetrago system/Legends|Öetrago system]], a part of the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was covered with what could almost be objectively viewed as unattractive [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life.<ref name="SWR" /><ref name="CE" />

At some point by [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited Öetrago.<ref name="TCS" />

After the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], following the [[Battle of Ithor|devastation]] of their homeworld, [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], sought to a new homeworld. Many of the survivors built colonies on Öetrago, [[Upell]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]<ref name="TEA" /> and, eventually, [[Borao]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
